mentions.name: Stacky Bird
mentions.description: A browser game that teaches kids stack-based programming through Flappy Bird-style gameplay. Levels award a new instruction each time, building up to a complete instruction set that can solve complicated puzzles, and players can revisit earlier levels to solve them more elegantly with newly earned instructions. Inspired by old HP calculators, 2048, and Flappy Bird. Not mobile friendly yet, though level videos can be viewed on mobile.
mentions.audience: Kids learning programming (the author's own kids)
mentions.source_excerpt: I've created a programming language and game for (my) kids called Stacky Bird. You learn Stack Based programming with Flappy Bird. Inspired by my old HP calculators, the game 2048 and Flappy Bird. In levels you earn a new instruction  and at the end you have a complete instruction set, and can solve complicated puzzles.
